# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_RIBBON_CONFLUENCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price pulling back to VWAP during a bullish EMA ribbon alignment offers a high-probability long entry when accompanied by bullish candle strength and above-average volume. This edge exists because VWAP acts as dynamic support in intraday uptrends, and the confluence of bullish ribbon structure, strong closing price action, and volume expansion indicates institutional absorption of pullbacks, creating favorable risk-reward entries.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When price crosses VWAP from below to close above VWAP on a candle, EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 (bullish ribbon), candle close > open (bullish body) and volume > 1.5 * 20-period average volume, enter long at close. Exit shape: Chart-stop placed below the most recent swing low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trailed at 15% off highest‑water‑mark using chandelier trail. Regime hint: Best in low‑to‑moderate volatility (VIX < 22) and during the morning session (09:30‑11:30) when VWAP is most relevant; avoid choppy, sideways days where price repeatedly crosses VWAP without direction.
